summary: Testing of Order Status Buttons Feature - All 12 requirements passed. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed. Frontend: All UI features verified via Playwright. The status system has been successfully migrated to 4 statuses (pending, processing, completed, cancelled) with action buttons replacing the dropdown select.

passed_tests.feature_1_status_filters: ✓ PASS: Admin orders page shows only 4 status filter buttons: Ожидает, Обработка, Выполнен, Отменён (no Новый, Отправлен, Доставлен)
passed_tests.feature_2_pending_order_buttons: ✓ PASS: Expanded pending order shows 'Принять' (blue) and 'Отменить' (red outline) buttons - NO dropdown
passed_tests.feature_3_accept_button_works: ✓ PASS: Clicking 'Принять' changes order status from pending to processing (verified #f52f3c59)
passed_tests.feature_4_processing_order_buttons: ✓ PASS: Expanded processing order shows 'Выполнен' (green) and 'Отменить' buttons - NO 'Принять' button
passed_tests.feature_5_complete_button_api: ✓ PASS: PUT /api/admin/orders/{id} with status=completed works (backend test)
passed_tests.feature_6_completed_order_no_buttons: ✓ PASS: Completed orders do NOT show status action buttons (Принять/Выполнен/Отменить)
passed_tests.feature_7_completed_no_edit: ✓ PASS: Completed orders do NOT show 'Редактировать' button
passed_tests.feature_8_cancelled_order_no_buttons: ✓ PASS: Cancelled orders do NOT show status action buttons or 'Редактировать' button
passed_tests.feature_9_client_status_labels: ✓ PASS: Client OrdersPage shows correct Russian labels: Ожидает, Обработка (no old labels)
passed_tests.feature_12_no_dropdown: ✓ PASS: No dropdown/select elements for status in the order action bar area
